query: Using 'yellow_card_train.csv' as the training dataset and 'yellow_card_test.csv' as the test dataset, create a binary label 'has_yellow' where 1 means the player received at least one yellow card in the appearance and 0 otherwise. Once 'has_yellow' is created, the column 'yellow_cards' must not be used as a feature for training or prediction. Use only numerical features for training (except label). Use a train/valid split of 80/20 (random_state=42) on 'yellow_card_train.csv'. Use the validation set to select the best max_depth from [3, 5, 10, None] for a DecisionTreeClassifier (random_state=42) based on accuracy. Retrain the model with the best max_depth on the full 'yellow_card_train.csv' and report the model accuracy on 'yellow_card_test.csv'.

Using 'yellow_card_train.csv' as the training dataset and 'yellow_card_test.csv' as the test dataset, create a binary label 'has_yellow' where 1 means the player received at least one yellow card in the appearance and 0 otherwise. Once 'has_yellow' is created, the column 'yellow_cards' must not be used as a feature for training or prediction. Use only numerical features for training (except label). Perform a train/valid split based on game_id on 'yellow_card_train.csv': randomly assign 80% of unique game_ids to the training set and the remaining 20% to the validation set (use random_state=42 when shuffling game_ids). Verify that no game_id appears in both the training set and the validation set. Use the validation set to select the best max_depth from [3, 5, 10, None] for a DecisionTreeClassifier (random_state=42) based on accuracy. Retrain the model with the best max_depth on the full 'yellow_card_train.csv' and report the model accuracy on 'yellow_card_test.csv'.
